Retained final-market delivery remains a separate boundary. Do not subtract native internal collection or invent a balancing heat/energy credit. The two minor producer routes are not identical technologies: mixed scrap has different diesel/yield/waste-treatment/facility allocation; the tinplate route hands off tinplate scrap and may carry different sorting, tin and recycling-allocation burdens. Replacing both complete internal supply models with native collected/sorted/pressed ferrous scrap is an explicit feedstock, yield, treatment and allocation proxy. Their combined source share is approximately 0.4095%; retain each original share and supported caller uncertainty, without asserting impact insignificance or chemical equivalence.
